Definition: from G3201; blame, i.e. (by implication), a fault:--quarrel.
BiblicalUsage: Momphe is a quarrel, a complaint — Paul tells the Colossians to forbear one another and forgive one another, if any man have a quarrel against any.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the quarrel is the test of forgiveness: it is easy to forgive no one in particular, and hard to forgive the one with a name.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
